findings.title: Update-available highlight toggle silently removed
findings.problem: showUpdateBanner()/dismissUpdateBanner() no longer toggle document.getElementById('installation-group').classList and document.getElementById('update-cli-tile').dataset.state, but #installation-group and #update-cli-tile still exist in ui/index.html and styles.css still defines #installation-group.update-available and #update-cli-tile[data-state="highlight"].
findings.impact: The accent-border visual cue that an update is available on the CLI tile is silently lost even though the elements and CSS it depends on are still shipped, making the loss look accidental rather than a deliberate scope decision; the CSS rules become unreachable dead code.
findings.recommendation: Re-add the classList.add('update-available') / dataset.state='highlight' toggle in showUpdateBanner() and the matching cleanup in dismissUpdateBanner(), or explicitly remove the now-dead CSS rules if the highlight is intentionally dropped.

findings.title: Version badge never clears after update
findings.problem: identity-version-badge is only ever set to non-empty text in the boot() version-check callback when cliVersionState.updateAvailable is true; neither dismissUpdateBanner() nor the successful-update path in runUpdateCli() (which sets cliVersionState.updateAvailable = false and calls dismissUpdateBanner()) ever clears identity-version-badge back to empty.
findings.impact: After a user dismisses the update banner or successfully completes the CLI update, the identity-bar badge keeps showing "<version> available" for the rest of the session with no way to clear it, misrepresenting current update status.
findings.recommendation: Clear document.getElementById('identity-version-badge').textContent inside dismissUpdateBanner() and again after a successful runUpdateCli() completion when cliVersionState.updateAvailable becomes false.
